title: DOS of CreateBondingCurve
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `CreateBondingCurve` instruction requires passing `bonding_curve_token_account`:  ```rust     #[account(         init,         payer = creator,         associated_token::mint = mint,         associated_token::authority = bonding_curve,     )]     bonding_curve_token_account: Box<Account<'info, TokenAccount>>, ```  `bonding_curve_token_account` uses `associated_token::mint` and `associated_token::authority`, so the `TokenAccount` can be created in advance.
